$comment: External design/content connectors. They SUPPLEMENT the internal system and are never a dependency: every one of them can be unavailable and the daily run still completes.

unsplash.use_when: No client photo, no approved internal background, and the campaign genuinely needs a photograph.
unsplash.never_when: A suitable client or internal image exists.

mobbin.description: Visual-pattern research. Layout, spacing, hierarchy and typography inspiration.
mobbin.use_when: The internal reference library is thin for this campaign, or the design direction has gone stale.
mobbin.never_when: The internal library already has an approved reference that scores well.

figma.description: Master design system and editable source files.
figma.use_when: An editable master layout or a reusable component system is being built or revised.
figma.never_when: A routine daily flyer that the internal renderer handles.

canva.use_when: The client has asked for an editable file, or an approved Canva template gives a real production advantage.
canva.never_when: Deterministic rendering already produces the deliverable.

reference_source_scores.$comment: Multiplies a reference's score. Internal approved work always outranks anything external.

thresholds.$comment: Tuning knobs for the decision engine. Raise these to spend less on external calls.
